summary.text: Great Wisdom grotto-heaven is Great Wisdom Immortal Mother's inkman habitat, invaded by Heavenly Court's Demon Judgment Board.

claims.text: Demon Judgment Board pierces the grotto-heaven wall and enters Great Wisdom grotto-heaven. Inside, the three Heavenly Court immortals see lush mountains and flowing rivers, with inkmen living in a flourishing habitat of many people. Demon Judgment Board lists the inkman Gu Immortals inside. The grotto-heaven holds many inkmen and cities; the biggest city sits at the center and gathers the largest number of inkman Gu Immortals. Defenders try the grotto-heaven’s main formation, a black fog that traps and infiltrates Demon Judgment Board, before the house destroys the immortal city and most defending immortals. A dying inkman Gu Immortal says the owner of Great Wisdom grotto-heaven will not let them off. Great Wisdom Immortal Mother, away with Wu Shuai’s force, cries that her Great Wisdom grotto-heaven is under attack and in imminent peril.

Wu Shuai treats Great Wisdom grotto-heaven as an allied headquarters attacked by Heavenly Court and orders Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch to lead a rescue in black heaven to preserve its foundation. Before that force can leave, Great Wisdom Immortal Mother says Heavenly Court has completely taken the grotto-heaven down.

Narration later calls her an inkman Gu Immortal whose Great Wisdom grotto-heaven Heavenly Court invaded with heavy losses. The two heavens alliance organized a rescue, but Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch disregarded Great Wisdom grotto-heaven while worrying over Ice Crystal grotto-heaven.
Recounting also says she sold racial inheritance information on the Qian Kun Crystal Wall to Wu Shuai to save Great Wisdom grotto-heaven.
